# exo_mailbox_calendar_folder (Resource)

Manages the MailboxCalendarFolder configuration via Set-MailboxCalendarFolder.

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `detail_level` (String) Maps to the -DetailLevel parameter.
- `publish_date_range_from` (String) Maps to the -PublishDateRangeFrom parameter.
- `publish_date_range_to` (String) Maps to the -PublishDateRangeTo parameter.
- `publish_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -PublishEnabled parameter.
- `reset_url` (Boolean) Maps to the -ResetUrl parameter.
- `searchable_url_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -SearchableUrlEnabled parameter.
- `set_as_sharing_source` (Boolean) Maps to the -SetAsSharingSource parameter.

- `use_https` (Boolean) Maps to the -UseHttps parameter.

### Read-Only
